display.summary: Three fixes found upgrading Trademarks to 1.16.5. Project scripts and stylesheets refresh in browsers after every upgrade: static URLs now carry the DjangoLux and project versions, so the proxy's year-long cache can no longer keep an old copy. A modal a project opens while its page loads, such as a ?modal= deep link, now opens instead of being lost. Confirming the current password no longer signs the user out once after a Django upgrade raises the password hasher's work factor. Web and worker update inline from any 1.16 release, with no migrations.
highlights: Project scripts refresh after every upgrade: static URLs carry the DjangoLux and project versions.
A modal opened while the page loads, such as a ?modal= deep link, now opens.
Confirming your password no longer signs you out after a Django upgrade re-hashes it.
Web and worker update inline from any 1.16 release, with no migrations.
